title.rendered: How to Use Presenter Preview and Background Replacements in macOS Sequoia

content.rendered:
Key Takeaways:

  • macOS Sequoia adds Presenter Preview and background replacements, giving Mac users more control and professionalism in video calls.
  • Presenter Preview lets you see shared content before others do, helping you manage privacy and avoid sharing the wrong screen or window.
  • Enable Presenter Preview in FaceTime by joining a call, clicking Share, hovering over apps, and selecting windows to share.
  • Background replacements let you blur or swap your background, using presets or custom images to keep calls distraction-free.
  • Turn backgrounds on in FaceTime settings before a call, and disable anytime via menu bar controls for a quick return to normal.

With the release of macOS Sequoia, two new and innovative features, presenter preview and background replacements, have been introduced, aiming to make video conferencing on a Mac even better.

While presenter preview gives you greater control over what you’re going to share in video calling apps, background replacements make you look professional with custom backdrops. Keep reading, and we’ll show you how to use presenter preview and video call background replacements in macOS Sequoia to improve your video-conferencing experience on a Mac.

Table of Contents
  • How to use presenter preview on Mac in macOS Sequoia
  • How to use video call backgrounds on Mac in macOS Sequoia

How to use presenter preview on Mac in macOS Sequoia

Presenter preview in macOS Sequoia is a new feature that lets you see what you’ll share in a video-calling app before you start a screen-sharing session. Not only does this make screen sharing easy, but it also gives you more control over what you’re sharing to safeguard your private data.

When you enable this feature, you can hover over an app window to highlight it and view what will be shown to others when you share it. Not only that, once you start a screen-sharing session, you can see which app windows you’re sharing, remove them, or even add new windows on the fly.

Follow the steps below to learn how to use presenter preview on a Mac:

  1. Open FaceTime on your Mac.
  2. Join a video call or start a new one.
  3. Click the Share icon located alongside other controls in the bottom-left corner of the screen.
  4. Hover over the app windows you want to share. You’ll see they’re highlighted.
  5. Preview the content of the highlighted app window that you’re about to share.
  6. Click Share this Window to start sharing it or hit Cancel to replace the window.
  7. Once you start screen sharing, click the purple presentation icon in the menu bar.
  8. Click Currently Sharing to view all the app windows you’re sharing currently.
  9. Click the – icon in the top-left corner of an app window to stop sharing it in the video call.
  10. If you want to share more apps, click the presentation icon again and select Change.
  11. Hover over the new app window you want to share and click Add This Window.

How to use video call backgrounds on Mac in macOS Sequoia

The background replacements feature in macOS Sequoia does exactly what it says. It allows you to change your backdrops in video calls. You can pick a gradient, wallpaper, or a custom image to replace what’s placed behind you before joining a video call or meeting.

Here’s how to enable a video call background on macOS Sequoia-compatible Macs:

  1. Open FaceTime on your Mac. Don’t join or start a call.
  2. Click the green FaceTime icon in the menu bar.
  3. Click Background to enable video call backgrounds.
  4. Click the box located beside the Background option.
  5. Choose a background from the resulting dialog box.
  6. If you want to add a custom background, go to the third tab.
  7. Click the + button and select either From Photos or Choose.
  8. Pick a photo for the background, hit Choose, and join the call. (The Choose button only appears when choosing photos via Finder.)

When you activate the background replacements feature, it will replace the background behind you with your selected image.

If you want to turn this feature off, it’s easy. Simply click the green FaceTime icon in the menu bar and deselect the Background option.

Video conferencing made better!

Presenter preview and background replacements are two of the best macOS Sequoia features. By following the steps outlined in this step-by-step guide, you can take full advantage of these new features and improve your video-conferencing experience while maintaining your privacy.

I personally find the video call background replacements feature to be really useful, as I no longer need to worry about my room being untidy during meetings. While presenter preview also seems useful, I don’t think I’ll be using it that often.

What do you think about these video conferencing features in macOS Sequoia? Let us know in the comments section located below.

step.text: Click Share this Window to start sharing the highlighted app window or hit Cancel to pick a different one.

itemListElement.text: Click Share this Window to present the selected app.
Click Cancel if you want to choose another window.

step.name: Open presenter controls
step.text: Once you start screen sharing, click the purple presentation icon in the menu bar to manage your shared windows.

itemListElement.text: Find the purple presentation icon near the right side of the menu bar.
Click the icon to open presenter controls.

step.name: View what you are sharing
step.text: Click Currently Sharing to view all the app windows you are sharing right now.

itemListElement.text: Select Currently Sharing to see thumbnails of shared apps.

step.name: Stop sharing a window
step.text: Click the minus icon in the top left of a shared window to stop presenting that window in the call.

itemListElement.text: Hover a shared window preview and click the minus icon to remove it.

step.name: Change what you share
step.text: If you want to add more apps, click the presentation icon again and choose Change to pick additional windows.

itemListElement.text: Click the presentation icon in the menu bar.
Click Change to browse more windows.

step.name: Add another window
step.text: Hover over the new app window you want to share and click Add This Window to include it in your presentation.

itemListElement.text: Hover the app window you want to add.
Click Add This Window to start sharing it.

@graph.name: How to use video call backgrounds on Mac in macOS Sequoia
@graph.description: Learn how to enable and customize video call backgrounds in FaceTime on your Mac running macOS Sequoia for a more polished and personal look.

step.name: Open FaceTime
step.text: Open FaceTime on your Mac but don’t join or start a call yet.

itemListElement.text: Click the FaceTime app in the Dock or Launchpad.
Keep the app open without joining a call.

step.name: Open menu bar controls
step.text: Click the green FaceTime icon in the menu bar to reveal background options.

itemListElement.text: Locate the FaceTime icon in the top menu bar.
Click the icon to open the quick controls.

step.name: Enable backgrounds
step.text: Click Background to enable video call backgrounds in FaceTime.

itemListElement.text: Click Background from the dropdown menu.

step.name: Select background box
step.text: Click the box located beside the Background option to manage available backgrounds.

itemListElement.text: Click the square box next to Background.

step.name: Choose a preset background
step.text: Choose a background from the dialog box that appears to instantly apply it.

itemListElement.text: Browse the available backgrounds.
Click a background to preview and apply it.

step.name: Add a custom background
step.text: If you want to add your own, go to the third tab in the dialog box. Click the plus button and choose From Photos or Choose to add a custom background.

itemListElement.text: Open the third tab in the background selector.
Click the plus button and select From Photos or Choose.

step.name: Set background and join call
step.text: Pick a photo for the background, hit Choose, and then join your FaceTime call. The Choose button only appears when selecting photos via Finder.

itemListElement.text: Select a photo from Photos or Finder.
Click Choose to set it as your background.
Join your call with the selected background applied.

keyPoints.title: Introduction of New Features in macOS Sequoia
keyPoints.explanation: macOS Sequoia introduces presenter preview and background replacements to enhance video conferencing on Mac, making it more manageable and professional.

keyPoints.title: How to Use Presenter Preview on Mac
keyPoints.explanation: Presenter preview allows users to see what they are sharing in a video call before starting, giving better control and privacy over screen sharing.

keyPoints.title: Steps for Activating Presenter Preview in FaceTime
keyPoints.explanation: Users can enable presenter preview in FaceTime by joining a call, clicking the share icon, hovering over apps to highlight, and choosing to share or add windows.

keyPoints.title: Using Background Replacements for Video Calls
keyPoints.explanation: Background replacements enable users to customize or blur their backgrounds with preset images or custom photos before joining a video call.

keyPoints.title: How to Enable and Disable Video Call Backgrounds
keyPoints.explanation: Activate background replacements through FaceTime settings before a call, and turn it off by deselecting the feature in menu bar controls for privacy and professionalism.
